content.comment_body: Hello! Does anyone have any example programs for establishing communication between a [product_name] and a ProFace device? I was able to send a basic bit signal from a [product_name] input to my ProFace L4301TM (modular analog/digital) touch panel, but I haven't managed to send signals in the opposite direction yet. I'm attaching my simple programs for reference. The challenge might be related to TSAP configuration—I'm really stuck at this point. These devices are used in our school for educational purposes, and we're hoping someone with expertise can offer advice.
Maybe this resource will be useful: [url] Just as an additional note, you typically can't write to an input or a network output that's currently connected to an input.
Hello, You can't write to a digital or analog input, as they are always managed by the [product_name]. Hope this assists.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are trying to set up communication between [product_name] hardware and a ProFace touch panel for educational purposes. The initial user can send signals from the [product_name] to the ProFace panel but not vice versa, leading to confusion regarding system configuration and operational limitations. Subsequent responses clarify that inputs on the [product_name] are read-only and cannot be written to by external devices, pointing out a limitation or misunderstanding in the devices' communication setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The main expectation is to achieve bi-directional data exchange between a [product_name] and a ProFace panel, specifically sending data from the ProFace device to [product_name] inputs or network outputs. The user is seeking example solutions or technical guidance to accomplish this.
